title: Two Interpretations of Night
content: The deep darkness of a moonless night has to be painted from memory.Here are two such interpretations, the first a scene in Warsaw in 1892, by Polish artistJózef Pankiewicz, with dim lamplight and a horse-drawn carriage coming or going in the center left.This one by Isaac Levitan is very dark too, with the tree masses painted very softly and full of mystery.
